### Quick Install (Recommended)

The fastest path — one command scaffolds the project and starts the dev server:

````
npx loopar-install my-project --port 8080
````

### Manual Install from Git

> #### Requires Node.js 22+ and Yarn 4+ (enable with `corepack enable`)

````
1. git clone https://github.com/alphabit-technology/loopar-framework.git my-project
2. cd my-project
3. yarn install
4. yarn dev
5. Continue in your browser
````

### Installation Wizard

When the install completes, the server starts and you can open it in your browser. The system shows a setup wizard where you define your database type and connection data, then your project details. Once finished, your installation is complete and you can start designing your projects.

### Build for Production

Thanks to the power of Vite, Loopar can be released to production easily:

````
yarn build
yarn start
````

`yarn build` produces a versioned release and activates it; `yarn start` runs the site in production mode under PM2.

For public domains and automatic SSL, Loopar integrates with **Caddy** — see the Deployment guide for details.
